command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
id
printf 'os='; uname -sr
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- existing paths ---'
for p in /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; else printf 'missing %s\n' "$p"; fi
done
printf '%s\n' '--- existing mount ---'
findmnt -T /mnt/inventory 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- fstab inventory entries ---'
awk '$0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && ($1=="/srv/inventory" || $2=="/mnt/inventory") {print NR ":" $0}' /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null || true
